## ROCnReg

*ROC curve inference with and without covariates* · R package · [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ROCnReg/index.html) · [Paper](https://journal.r-project.org/articles/RJ-2021-066/) · [Talk (YouTube, 50 min)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ifsmVKafdVA&t=1839s)

**ROCnReg** estimates ROC curves and related summaries of discriminatory accuracy, using both frequentist and Bayesian methods. When it was released, it was the only R package implementing Bayesian procedures for ROC curves.

- Pooled, covariate-specific and covariate-adjusted ROC curves
- Parametric, semiparametric and nonparametric estimators, within both the Bayesian and frequentist paradigms
- Summary measures such as the (partial) area under the curve and the Youden index
- ROC-based optimal thresholds under several criteria (e.g., the Youden index)
- For the Bayesian methods: model checking via posterior predictive checks and model choice via information criteria
- Numerical and graphical output for all methods

```r
install.packages("ROCnReg")
```

**How to cite:** Rodriguez-Alvarez, M.X. and Inacio, V. (2021). ROCnReg: An R package for receiver operating characteristic curve inference with and without covariates. *The R Journal*, **13**, 525--555. [doi:10.32614/RJ-2021-066](https://doi.org/10.32614/RJ-2021-066)

## DDPstar

*Bayesian nonparametric density regression* · R package · [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/DDPstar/index.html) · [Paper](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11222-025-10567-0) · [Talk (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qPPXAezt8ys&t=2805s)

**DDPstar** fits a flexible and computationally tractable model for density regression, based on a single-weights dependent Dirichlet process mixture of normal distributions for a univariate continuous response.

- Additive structure for the mean of each mixture component
- Smooth nonlinear effects of continuous covariates via penalised B-splines and their bivariate tensor-product extension
- Also handles parametric effects of categorical covariates, linear effects, interactions, varying-coefficient terms and random effects

```r
install.packages("DDPstar")
```

**How to cite:** Rodriguez-Alvarez, M.X., Inacio, V. and Klein, N. (2025). Density regression via Dirichlet process mixtures of normal structured additive regression models. *Statistics and Computing*, **35**, 47. [doi:10.1007/s11222-025-10567-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11222-025-10567-0)

*Note:* a faster C++ implementation of the **DDPstar** sampler, the R package [**ddpfast**](https://github.com/hugogobato/ddpfast), was introduced in a contributed discussion (p. 58) of MacEachern's [*Dependent Dirichlet Processes*](https://doi.org/10.1214/26-BA1610) in *Bayesian Analysis*.
